title: Let's Rock, Let's Roll

shots: Over the edge. The instant the rear wheels leave the broken lip of the toppled tower. Camera low on the rubble ramp just behind and below the car, wide-angle lens, frame tilted about 15 degrees. The sports car fills the lower-left third, its nose already dipping out over nothing, rear wheels spinning free, sparks and chunks of concrete spraying off the edge toward the camera. Silas, in sunglasses, clings flat to the rear spoiler with his coat whipping back at us; through the rear window, the dark shapes of the others, also in sunglasses. Beyond the car the ground falls away fifty storeys: the burning capital far below, its city wall a thin line, then open night sky and moonlit farmland ahead. Orange firelight from below, cold moonlight from above.

Heroic from below. The top of the jump's arc. Extreme low angle from far beneath, looking almost straight up: the car's underside and spinning wheels silhouetted against an enormous full moon, headlights blazing, placed in the upper-right third. Dust and debris stream back from where it left the tower, at the lower left. Orange firelight from the burning city below lights the faces in the side windows: Elspeth gripping the wheel, Olivia and Leliana beside her, all in sunglasses. Silas clings to the roof, coat flapping against the stars. The rest of the frame is deep night sky.

Epic wide. Huge establishing shot at the peak of the arc. The car is small, high in the upper-right third, far above the capital's city wall, trailing a long plume of dust from the toppled research tower at the left edge of the frame; one strong diagonal runs from the tower's broken top to the car. In the lower-left corner the capital burns, and glowing winged angel-soldiers rise out of the smoke in pursuit while a warplane banks in from the distance. The right side of the frame opens into empty moonlit sky over dark forest and farmland: freedom ahead, fire behind.
